agent_role: Red Team Staff Audit, Local/Network/Server Logging & Telemetry Inquisitor

invariants: NO global typecheck (Mandate 8t: isolated node --import tsx --test only)
Three-tier logging architecture: Local -> LAN P2P -> Server

defects_cataloged_and_fixed.title: Split-brain offline audit buffers between clientLogger and staffTelemetryService
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.detail: clientLogger maintained an internal offlineStaffAuditBuffer using 'dente_offline_staff_audit_buffer', while staffTelemetryService maintained an internal queue using 'dente_staff_audit_events_v1', resulting in two uncoordinated queues, duplicate flushes, and lost pending counts.
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.remediation: Unified queues under staffTelemetryService as the single source of truth (SSOT). clientLogger delegates recordStaffAction, getPendingStaffAuditCount, and flushStaffAuditBuffer directly to staffTelemetryService. Dual persistence automatically mirrors to both 'dente_staff_audit_events_v1' and 'dente_offline_staff_audit_buffer' with zero data loss.

defects_cataloged_and_fixed.title: Lack of local IndexedDB persistence for staff action audit queue
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.detail: Staff audit queue relied exclusively on synchronous localStorage (5MB limit, failure in private browsing), risking loss of critical audit logs upon browser crash or private tab close.
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.remediation: Implemented asynchronous IndexedDB backing ('dente_staff_audit_db' store 'staff_events') alongside localStorage for full resilience against power failure and quota overflow.

defects_cataloged_and_fixed.title: Missing LAN P2P broadcast layer for real-time staff actions
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.detail: Staff action telemetry events were never broadcast to peer workstations (e.g. reception desk when doctor applies discount or closes shift).
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.remediation: Extended LanP2PDispatcher with broadcastStaffAction and onStaffActionTelemetry for instantaneous peer-to-peer distribution across BroadcastChannel and WebSocket.

defects_cataloged_and_fixed.title: Incomplete schema action types in staffActionTypeSchema
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.detail: staffActionTypeSchema in packages/shared was missing essential clinic workflow action types.
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.remediation: Added appointment_create, appointment_reschedule, appointment_delete, diary_revision, auth_login, auth_logout, material_adjustment.

defects_cataloged_and_fixed.title: Missing server-side audit logging in appointments and billing routes
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.detail: createAppointmentHandler and updateAppointmentHandler in apps/api/src/routes/appointments.ts had zero calls to recordAuditEventInDb. createPaymentHandler and partialRefundHandler in apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts also lacked recordAuditEventInDb calls.
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.remediation: Plugged audit holes in routes/appointments.ts (appointment_create, appointment_reschedule, appointment_cancel) and routes/billing.ts (payment_receive, payment_refund) attributing actorUserId and organizationId.

defects_cataloged_and_fixed.title: Frontend schedule mutation hook missing audit trail
defects_cataloged_and_fixed.detail: useAppointmentMutations.ts had zero integration with staff action audit services upon appointment draft creation and schedule saves.
